title: Personal Loan Eligibility Policy
content: The Personal Loan Eligibility Policy requires a minimum credit score of 650. Applicants must have an annual income of at least $25,000. The maximum acceptable debt-to-income (DTI) ratio is 40%. Applicants must show at least 6 months of continuous employment history. Loan amounts range from $2,000 to $50,000 with terms of 12 to 60 months. Applicants who do not meet the minimum credit score may be offered a secured personal loan alternative at branch discretion.

title: Auto Loan Eligibility Policy
content: The Auto Loan Eligibility Policy requires a minimum credit score of 620. Applicants must have an annual income of at least $20,000. The maximum acceptable debt-to-income (DTI) ratio is 45%. Applicants must show at least 3 months of continuous employment history. The vehicle being financed must be less than 10 years old, and loan-to-value (LTV) may not exceed 120% of the vehicle's appraised value.

title: Mortgage (Home Loan) Eligibility Policy
content: The Mortgage Eligibility Policy requires a minimum credit score of 680. Applicants must have an annual income of at least $40,000. The maximum acceptable debt-to-income (DTI) ratio is 43%. Applicants must show at least 24 months of continuous employment history. Maximum loan-to-value (LTV) is 95%, requiring a minimum 5% down payment. Private mortgage insurance (PMI) is required for any LTV above 80%.

title: Credit Card Eligibility Policy
content: The Credit Card Eligibility Policy requires a minimum credit score of 600. Applicants must have an annual income of at least $15,000. The maximum acceptable debt-to-income (DTI) ratio is 50%. Applicants must show at least 3 months of continuous employment history. Initial credit limits range from $500 to $25,000 based on internal risk tier.

title: General Pre-Qualification and KYC Requirements
content: General Pre-Qualification and KYC Requirements apply to all loan and credit products. Applicants must be at least 18 years old, a U.S. resident with a valid Social Security Number, and must provide a government-issued photo ID. Applicants with an active bankruptcy filed within the last 24 months are not eligible for any credit product until the bankruptcy is discharged. All pre-qualification checks described here are soft inquiries and do not affect the applicant's credit score.
